integrity: The theorem is proved for all admitted finite graphs using a combinatorial support classification and conditional-priority counting; exact-rational finite checks are corroborative only. A historical-priority search does not constitute proof of worldwide novelty.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple, balanced, regular, four-cycle-free deleted bipartite graph; uniform vertex permutation. No claim for graphs with a four-cycle in the deleted incidence graph, nonregular deletions, or alternative greedy procedures. The \(n^{3/2}\) envelope is asymptotic along admissible parameter sequences and is attained along prime-power projective planes.
title: Exact rare-catastrophe law for greedy independent sets on complements of four-cycle-free bipartite graphs
